title: Chocolate
description: A Vanilla+ mod that aims to improve upon the minecraft experience with a new dimension and many new items.
body:
# Chocolate

Chocolate is a vanilla+ mod for Minecraft 1.21.1 that adds a collection of useful commands, food items, and quality-of-life features while staying close to the vanilla experience.

## Features

### Commands

* `/chocolate spawn <mob> <amount> <radius>` — Spawn entities around you. <OP>
* `/chocolate kill <mob> <amount> <radius>` — Remove nearby entities. <OP>
* `/chocolate target <mob> <target>` — Force mobs to target another entity. <OP>
* `/chocolate biome` — View your current biome.
* `/chocolate biome change` — Change biome areas. <OP>
* `/chocolate coord` — View your coordinates.
* `/chocolate coord tell` — Share your coordinates with everyone.
* `/chocolate runasother` — Execute commands as another player. <OP>

### Food

* Chocolate Cake
* Chocolate Milk
* Uranium
* Refined Uranium

### Mobs

* Brown Cow
* fear.
* Event Horizon (BOSS)

### Blocks
* Uranium Block
* Antimatter
* Antimatter Converter

### Items
* Chocolate
* Chocolate Milk
* Antimatter Talisman
* Chocolate Cake

### Extra
* Antimatter Void Dimension
* Two Music Discs

## Design Goals

Chocolate aims to expand Minecraft without changing its core gameplay. Features are designed to feel useful, simple, and fitting within a vanilla-style world.


## Notes

This mod is still actively being expanded and may receive additional content and quality-of-life features in future updates.

This is also my first Minecraft mod, and I sincerely hope that you enjoy playing it as much as I enjoyed creating it.
